classes.description: Document — 文档（版本化实体）。管理 SOP、图纸、安全手册等文件的元数据和版本控制。通过 identifier 指定外部文件路径/URL，fileLocation/fileName 定位文件，viewer 指定查看器，支持 XShare 协作系统集成。被 DocumentSet 引用组成文档集。 【Swagger】Schema: DocumentEntity；来源文件: Documents.json；API: /api/Documents。

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 限制的设置权限限制 → SetupAccess 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: changeHistory
properties.description: 变更历史记录 【Swagger】引用 Schema: ChangeHistoryChanges。

properties.name: revision
properties.description: 修订版本号（必填） 【Swagger】Revision (unique within the context of the base entity)

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance

properties.description: 关联的图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.description: 关联的文档基类 → DocumentBase

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr

properties.description: 关联的文档查看器(DocumentViewer) 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.description: 外部标识符——文件路径 and 文件名、URL等 【Swagger】External identifier for the document (Path and file name, URL, etc.)

properties.description: 状态：1=Active, 2=Inactive 【Swagger】Determines the current status (Active, In-Active) of this instance. Valid values and their meanings are: 1 = Active 2 = Inactive

classes.description: DocumentViewer — 文档查看器。定义打开特定类型文档所使用的外部应用程序及命令行参数。commandLine 中 %1 令牌在运行时被替换为文档的 identifier/路径。例如："Acrobat.exe %1" 用 PDF 阅读器打开文档。 【Swagger】Schema: DocumentViewerEntity；来源文件: DocumentViewers.json；API: /api/DocumentViewers。

properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.description: 关联的图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: currentDirectory
properties.description: 应用程序启动时的当前工作目录 【Swagger】Optionally specifies the directory to be used as the current directory when the application is launched.

properties.name: commandLine
properties.description: 启动应用程序的命令行，%1 令牌代表文档路径（最长2000字符） 【Swagger】Specifies the name of the application to launch and any command line arguments that are required. This string includes an identifier that is to be replaced with a document identifier when the command string is constructed at run-time. For example: Acrobat.exe %1 Where %1 is to be replaced with a document identifier at run time.

classes.description: DocumentEntry — 文档条目（DocumentSet 的子实体）。在文档集中引用一个具体的 Document，并提供在此集合中的用途说明(description)，以及一个名称(name)用于在关联步骤中请求特定文档。 【Swagger】Schema: DocumentEntryChanges；来源文件: DocumentSets.json；API: /api/DocumentSets。

properties.name: isFrozen

properties.name: documentSet
properties.description: 归属的文档集 → DocumentSet 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: name
properties.description: 条目名称，用于在关联步骤中标识和请求特定文档 【Swagger】Unique name for this Bin (unique within the context of the associated Step). This provides a means of requesting a specific document within the Set.

properties.name: description
properties.description: 条目的用途说明，用于构建选择列表 【Swagger】Description of this entry. Defaults to the name of this entry if not specified. This value is used, for example, to build a selection list of documents within the set.
